Title: Vihaan's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Vihaan - 10 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Pallavi - 41 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Vimla - 71 years, grandmother
Look: white saree, glasses
4. Meera - 11 years, friend
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair

Places

1. The bedroom - a big bed, a wooden cupboard
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
4. The park - green grass, swings, benches

Scene 1: The bedroom - Day

[Vihaan stands in the bedroom. Pallavi and Meera stand near him.]

Meera: "Today feels like a good day."

[Vihaan yawns loudly.]

Vihaan: "This is amazing!"

[Vihaan stretches his arms above his head.]

Vihaan: "Show me too!"

[Vihaan goes to bed and falls asleep.]

Vihaan (gently): "I'm ready!"

[Vihaan sits on the edge of the bed.]

Vihaan: "Mom, listen!"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Vihaan stands in the living room. Pallavi and Meera stand near him.]

Meera: "So, here we are!"

[Vihaan takes a bite of his sandwich.]

Vihaan (laughing): "Mom, listen!"

[Vihaan munches on an apple.]

Pallavi: "Oh wow!"

[Vihaan drinks a glass of water.]

Vihaan: "Let's see."

[Vihaan gulps down a glass of milk.]

Vihaan: "Exactly right."

[Vihaan serves hot rotis to Mother.]

Vihaan: "Okay, Meera."

Scene 3: The courtyard - Day

[Vihaan stands in the courtyard. Pallavi stands near him.]

Pallavi: "So, here we are!"

[Vihaan shakes his head.]

Vihaan: "Okay, Mom."

[Vihaan whispers something to Mother.]

Vihaan: "And then?"

Scene 4: The park - Day

[Vihaan stands in the park. Pallavi stands near him.]

Vihaan: "Mom, look over here."

[Vihaan throws the ball to Mother.]

Pallavi (happily): "Well done!"

[Vihaan catches the ball.]

Pallavi: "Oh wow!"

[Vihaan plays cricket in the park.]

Pallavi: "Vihaan, look at this."

[Vihaan swings on the swing.]

Pallavi: "Well done!"

[Vihaan plays on the see-saw with Mother.]

Pallavi (softly): "What next?"

[Vihaan feeds the birds.]

Pallavi: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
